site_name: Gumley House Convent School For Girls
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed floodlights would have an adverse effect on the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, the setting of the nearby Listed Buildings and the openness of the Local Open Space. It would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, ENV.1.2 and ENV1.3B of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996), Policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.2.2, ENV-B.2.5 and ENV-N.1.11 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development would be likely to lead to significant and unacceptable levels of noise and disturbance to surrounding occupiers. This would thereby be contrary to Policy ENV.7.1 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV.P 1.5 and C.5.1 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).
description: Conversion of grassed area to external all weather hockey pitch incorporating 5m high flood lights and 16m pitch to site.
